title: TLS/SSL Server Supports CBC Cipher Suites
description: The TLS server at mail.example.com:993 accepts CBC-mode cipher suites, which are susceptible to BEAST/Lucky13-style attacks.

remediation.summary: Disable CBC-mode cipher suites; prefer AEAD suites (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305).

evidence.content_redacted:
Nmap script ssl-enum-ciphers output excerpt:
TLSv1.2:
  ciphers:
    TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA - strong
    TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA - weak (CBC)
